purpose: Original project-bound streetscape asset expansion authorized by the human

new_assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production sprite for a north-up 2D top-down game, elevated camera about 55 degrees looking down, south/front toward the bottom of the image; horizontal frontage stays horizontal, not a diamond-isometric board. Art direction: a bright temperate Mediterranean/Roman civic city mixed with medieval European domestic life and restrained early municipal industry. Painterly game illustration with convincing material planes, grouped colours and broad shapes, matching detailed painted limestone/slate/clay buildings. Strong silhouette and selective crispness, quiet internal marks, no thick black outline and no individually outlined leaves/bricks. Soft warm sunlight comes from upper right, cool ambient shade on lower-left faces. Render one isolated object fully visible, centered with a small transparent margin. Genuinely transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard, no backdrop, no ground plane, no cast shadow baked on the background, no labels, no people, no interface, no text, no watermark.
Subject: one mature Mediterranean hackberry/fig-like broadleaf street tree with a substantial asymmetrical spreading canopy, 4 to 6 large interlocking leafy masses and a short visible forked grey-brown trunk. Medium sage/olive greens with a few warm sunlit tips and cooler green shaded core; healthy leafy temperate city, no palms, desert shrub, fruit or flowers. View enough of the canopy top to suit the elevated game camera; the trunk base is visible near lower center. The canopy must look lush and inhabited but have a few deliberate gaps and an irregular non-circular silhouette. Simplify foliage into painted masses readable when the whole tree is only about 120 screen pixels wide; do not draw hundreds of tiny high-contrast leaves. No planter, paving, surrounding objects or ground shadow. Square composition, tree occupies about 85% of canvas width and height. Ground contact is only the trunk/root base at bottom center.

Subject: one low, elongated, weathered cool limestone planter trough for a civic building corner. Its long front face runs horizontally, with a short shaded right return and a visible shallow top filled with dark moist earth. A generous asymmetrical grouped mass of sage-green ivy and a small leafy shrub grows from it, with a few broad trailing ivy strands over one side. Old pale stone with two or three broad worn blocks and chipped selected corners, subdued lime staining, no ornamental carving, no many tiny mortar lines. The planter has a believable grounded rectangular base and low walls; foliage is richer than the plain stone but grouped and not over-lined. No backing building, trellis, floor, bricks outside the planter, extra pots, props or separate floating leaves. Landscape 3:2 composition, whole object fully visible. This is a reusable corner/edge sprite, intended display roughly 80 to 110 screen pixels wide; keep the stone and foliage groups coherent at that size. Physical contact/anchor is the lowest middle of the stone base.

One complete fully visible isolated object with a small transparent margin. Subject: one reusable wall-mounted domestic linen window awning, cream/off-white weathered canvas with two broad faded sage-green stripes. Its back timber rail runs horizontally, the cloth slopes forward/down toward the viewer with a shallow irregular front valance, and two simple sturdy dark wrought-iron supports return to the wall attachment points. Show the fabric top and shallow front edge from the elevated game camera. Three broad tension folds, restrained cloth weave and sun wear, no many tiny scallops, fringe or ornate ornament. No wall, window, building, storefront text, flower boxes, posts reaching the ground or surrounding props. Landscape composition roughly 3:2. Intended display about 75–100 screen pixels wide; prioritize coherent fabric planes and a readable grounded mounting structure.

Subject: one practical shielded civic wall lantern, heavy weathered dark iron hood and simple frame, warm muted amber/cream glass, compact back mounting plate and one short sturdy arm. Show a shallow elevated south-facing view with visible hood top and shaded side. The lamp has two or three broad structural bars and one small visible fastener group, not intricate filigree. It belongs to old Roman/medieval stone retrofitted with early municipal service technology: ordinary purposeful hardware, not a magical shrine. Restrained patina and worn edges, the glass is lit within the physical lantern but absolutely no halo/bloom/glow outside its silhouette. No wall, cables trailing off-frame, chain, floor, symbols or text. Portrait composition. The head and mount must remain readable when total object is only 25–40 screen pixels high.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original seamless square repeating albedo/diffuse ground texture for a north-up top-down action game. Subject: old Mediterranean/Roman city street paving made of worn small angular limestone/basalt setts, broadly rectangular with rounded/chipped corners, imperfect staggered courses and occasional gentle changes in course alignment. Direct orthographic view straight down, no perspective, no horizon, no bevelled sample board. About 18–22 rows of modest varied units across the tile. Palette: desaturated cool blue-grey stone, mildly warmer selected worn faces, close-valued grey joints; overall middle-light daylight road, only modestly darker than chalk limestone frontage. Painterly grouped stone tones and very quiet fine texture; broad flat worn faces, avoid a dark outline or deep shadow around each stone. Stone joints must be low-contrast and dry, with restrained age; no wet glitter, heavy AO, grass, moss, dirt islands, cracks crossing the whole tile, text, border, vignette, lighting gradient or bright isolated highlights. Even diffuse illumination so runtime shadows can work. Left/right and top/bottom edges must continue seamlessly with consistent scale and colour, no surrounding transparency. This is functional repeatable game material rather than a scene or a photo of a paving sample.

followup_edits.prompt: Edit target: the supplied isolated limestone planter with ivy and shrub. Change ONLY its background/alpha cleanup. Preserve the entire planter, plants, composition, camera, painted materials, scale and lighting. Remove ALL green/yellow ambient glow, backdrop haze, ground plane and ground cast shadow outside the physical planter and foliage. Make everything outside the object truly alpha zero, including the empty gaps between leaves. Retain clean natural antialiased foliage edges without coloured matte/fringing, and keep the stone/plants opaque. Do not redraw, add labels, put it on a background, or create a new scene. Output a clean transparent production sprite.

source_processing: Selected PNG bytes copied unchanged. No raster repaint/crop/resize/background removal by local scripts; RGBA and bounds/hash inspection only. Runtime placement/tint/scaling is owned by implementation.
